LanguageData.OARatkin_LetterLabel_TributeCollectorArr: The Material Recruitment Team of Golden Iris Orchid
LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_TributeCollectorArrival: The Golden Iris Orchid recruitment team from {FACTION_name} has arrived at our residence and will stay here for a period of time. If we are willing, they will accept the gold, berries, and synthetic fibers we provide and record our contributions. When our contribution reaches a certain level, they will accept us and grant us noble status.
LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_SupplyShipShowConcern: The supply ship from {FACTION_name} Golden Iris extends our condolences and also gifts us {1} berries.
LanguageData.OARatkin_Letter_NewYearEvent:
To the sincere ally of the Golden Iris Orchid {MAP_label}：

According to the Iris Orchid Universal Calendar, the Iris Orchid Calendar will enter a new year in the coming days.
The hatred of the past will be let go, and the harmony of the future is not far away. On this special day, on behalf of the court staff of {FACTION_name}, I extend sincere greetings and blessings to {MAP_label}.In this brand new year, the Golden Iris Empire will continue to strive towards a harmonious world, and we will ultimately work together to create our own utopia.
Please accept some holiday gifts attached to this letter.

In addition, the attendants of the technical department have recently developed a new device. They believe that this little Rubik's Cube will be helpful to you to some extent, so they have attached it with this letter as a gesture of goodwill towards their friends.

Happy New Year.



{1} of {FACTION_name}
{LEADER_nameDef}。
